title: Record and recover explicit engineering decisions
description: Engineers and agents can record explicit current engineering facts through bounded tasks, preserve unresolved work and relied-upon judgments, and establish coherent outcomes after interruption.

includes: Supported current task creation/update, complete candidate validation and nonwriting preview.
Attributable current decisions, unresolved issue preservation and explicit support reconciliation.
Fresh atomic durable updates and internal ordinary transaction recovery; explicit whole-store maintenance has its separate contract.
excludes: Automatic workflow progression, supplied-decision approval, implied permission, or arbitrary engineering-document edits.
Legacy conversion outside the separate migration capability, operational backup restoration, arbitrary recovery choices on reads, or a transaction over all repository edits.
